methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. For each plan the monthlyUsd records the effective monthly cost for one seat / the smallest billable unit. Where only annual-billing rates were published, that annualized monthly rate is recorded and notes explains; month-to-month rates are noted separately when discovered. annualDiscountPct is set only when both annual and monthly rates were explicitly published on the same official source. Quote-only and enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd null. Prospero's correct domain is goprospero.com (the earlier prospero.io was wrong); its official pricing page publishes a confirmable self-serve price of $19/user/month month-to-month or $12/user/month billed annually. Bidsketch pricing was read from bidsketch.com/pricing/ and corroborated via softwareadvice.com. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null for every plan as this vertical is non-telephony.

vendors.name: PandaDoc
vendors.provenance: https://www.pandadoc.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Annual-billing rates confirmed. Month-to-month rates ($35 Starter, $65 Business) sourced from softwareadvice.com profile accessed 2026-06-14 as the pandadoc.com pricing page did not clearly display monthly rates. HIPAA compliance confirmed at pandadoc.com/security/.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited seats; 60 documents per year. Drag-and-drop editor, real-time tracking.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $19/seat/month billed annually. Month-to-month rate is $35/seat/month. 110 documents per year. Audit trail, bulk import, inline comments, 24/7 support. Additional documents $2 each (annual) or $3.50 each (monthly).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $49/seat/month billed annually. Month-to-month rate is $65/seat/month. Unlimited documents. Custom branding, CRM integrations, approval workflows, deal rooms.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom per-seat or per-document pricing. CPQ, workflow automation, smart content, SSO, team workspaces, Notary, API access.

vendors.name: Proposify
vendors.provenance: https://www.proposify.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Annual-billing rates confirmed as primary. Monthly-billed rates sourced from same page (Basic $29, Team $49). Business plan confirmed as quote-only starting $3,900/year via official page. HIPAA/BAA not mentioned on security page (proposify.com/security, accessed 2026-06-14 — SOC2 Type 2, GDPR, PCI-DSS confirmed instead). Corroborated via getapp.com.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $19/user/month billed annually; $29/user/month month-to-month. 10 document sends per month; overage $0.50/send. Up to 3 templates, e-signatures, document tracking. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $41/user/month billed annually; $49/user/month billed quarterly. Unlimited sending; 30 sends/month included, overage $0.30/send. Up to 10 templates, analytics, integrations, automations, custom fields.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Quote-only; starts at $3,900/year. 75 sends/month included, overage $0.75/send. Unlimited templates, user roles & permissions, SSO, API access, multiple workspaces, premium onboarding.

vendors.name: Better Proposals
vendors.provenance: https://betterproposals.io/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). Monthly rates are month-to-month prices; annual rates noted separately. HIPAA not mentioned on integrations page or pricing page.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $13/user/month billed monthly; annual billing brings this to $19/user/month (billed annually, saving up to 35%). 1 user seat, 10 document sends per month. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $21/user/month billed monthly; $29/user/month billed annually. Unlimited user seats, 50 document sends per month. Custom domain, CRM integrations, Zapier.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $42/user/month billed monthly; $49/user/month billed annually. Unlimited user seats, unlimited document sends. Password protection, content locking, manager approvals.

vendors.name: Qwilr
vendors.provenance: https://qwilr.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). All paid plans are annual-billing only. Starter also available month-to-month at $49/user/month. Growth requires minimum 5 seats; Scale requires minimum 10 seats. Corroborated via softwareadvice.com profile.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $35/user/month billed annually; $49/user/month billed monthly. E-signature, analytics, QwilrPay, HubSpot/Zoho/Pipedrive integrations, API access (10 free documents then $5/doc overage).

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $55/user/month, annual billing only. Minimum 5 seats ($275/month minimum). Dedicated CSM, automations, custom branding, team permissions, identity verification, enhanced reporting. API: 150 free docs then $2.50/doc.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $75/user/month, annual billing only. Minimum 10 seats ($750/month minimum). Salesforce integration, conditional content, Smart Proposal Engine, AI Prefill, professional services, chat support. API: 600 free docs then $2.50/doc.

vendors.name: Prospero
vendors.provenance: https://goprospero.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-14). The prior domain prospero.io was incorrect — the proposal-software vendor publishes at goprospero.com. Self-serve price is published and confirmable: $19/user/month month-to-month, $12/user/month billed annually (~37% off per official page). Corroborated via WebSearch citing goprospero.com and saasworthy.com (goprospero product). Unlimited proposals, 14-day free trial.
